capabilities: Convert selected text to a chosen case via editor commands
Pick a case from a list via a selection modal
Apply case changes across multiple selections in one undoable transaction
Apply locale-specific lower and upper case mappings for non-Latin alphabets
extras: README warns that Markdown formatting characters are stripped by some commands (e.g. camelCase), and that accents or other marks may be dropped when regrouping grapheme clusters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to change the capitalization of selected text.
summary: Case-conversion plugin that adds commands to change selected text between cases like camelCase, snake_case and UPPER CASE.
